title: The Terrace by AYANA
shortDescription: New hillside condo by AYANA in Layan; launch units of 32-48 sqm from THB 3.3M.
description: New hillside condominium by AYANA Phuket in Layan, Phuket, with tiered terraces facing the sea, forest or hills. First launch: 50 units of 32-48 sqm in Zones B and C from THB 3.3 million.
